label: intro
narration: Video 4: Agents Manager. Git is set up. Now RobOS needs to know which AI agent to use.

label: launch
narration: Dana searches for Agents Manager in the App Launcher and opens it.

label: not-authed
narration: GitHub Copilot is installed but not authenticated — yellow dot. She clicks Login.

label: device
narration: A terminal opens with the gh auth device flow. Same process as Git Login Manager, different scope.

label: authorize
narration: Code entered, access authorized. Back in Agents Manager, Dana hits Refresh.

label: green
narration: Green dot. Connected. Now she sets GitHub Copilot as the active provider.

label: done
narration: Every AI textarea in RobOS — Issue Manager, Workflow Studio, Git Projects — now has a working agent behind it.
